changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO connection_audit (connection_id, event_type, from_state, to_state, actor_kind, actor_ref, correlation_id, detail) SELECT id, 'UNVERIFIED_INSTALLATION', state, 'UNINSTALLED', 'SYSTEM', 'migration', 'migration-1790610365032-1', jsonb_build_object('reason', 'GitHub App installation was never verified') FROM connection WHERE kind = 'GITHUB' AND state <> 'UNINSTALLED' AND config ->> 'type' = 'GITHUB_APP' AND (config ->> 'installationId') IS DISTINCT FROM instance_key; UPDATE connection SET state = 'UNINSTALLED', state_reason = 'GitHub App installation was never verified', credentials_encrypted = NULL, credentials_alg = NULL, credentials_key_version = NULL, credentials_rotation_failed_at = NULL, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE kind = 'GITHUB' AND state <> 'UNINSTALLED' AND config ->> 'type' = 'GITHUB_APP' AND (config ->> 'installationId') IS DISTINCT FROM instance_key;

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.sql: WITH superseded AS ( SELECT id, state FROM connection c WHERE kind = 'GITHUB' AND state <> 'UNINSTALLED' AND config ->> 'type' = 'GITHUB_APP' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM connection earlier WHERE earlier.kind = 'GITHUB' AND earlier.state <> 'UNINSTALLED' AND earlier.config ->> 'type' = 'GITHUB_APP' AND earlier.instance_key = c.instance_key AND earlier.id < c.id) ), audited AS ( INSERT INTO connection_audit (connection_id, event_type, from_state, to_state, actor_kind, actor_ref, correlation_id, detail) SELECT id, 'SUPERSEDED_INSTALLATION', state, 'UNINSTALLED', 'SYSTEM', 'migration', 'migration-1790610365032-2', jsonb_build_object('reason', 'GitHub App installation is held by an earlier workspace') FROM superseded ) UPDATE connection SET state = 'UNINSTALLED', state_reason = 'GitHub App installation is held by an earlier workspace', credentials_encrypted = NULL, credentials_alg = NULL, credentials_key_version = NULL, credentials_rotation_failed_at = NULL, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM superseded);
